name: What types of renovations are best suited for a pre-move-in schedule?

mainEntity.name: What types of renovations are best suited for a pre-move-in schedule?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pre-move-in renovations are best for projects that require extensive work and create significant dust or disruption. This includes full-scale kitchen and bathroom remodels, flooring replacement throughout the home, interior wall removals or additions, and major plumbing or electrical upgrades. These larger projects benefit greatly from a vacant property, allowing for easier access, faster material delivery, and a cleaner work environment. Smaller cosmetic changes can also be done pre-move-in, but the biggest advantages are for more impactful projects.
acceptedAnswer.description: Extensive projects like full kitchen/bathroom remodels, flooring replacement, and structural changes are ideal for pre-move-in. A vacant home allows for easier access and cleaner work.
